# THE BILLING PLANES (plane_meter_seam_reachability.rs): every linked plane that performs billable
# work, keyed by its crate directory under crates/, and the ONE path that answers for its Meter step:
#   <crate> root <composition-root leg file under crates/busbar/src/root/>
#   <crate> served <crate>/<production file> <ledger step fn> <declared class const>
#   <crate> session <crate>/<turn step file> <turn step fn> <crate>/<class file> <class fn> <declared class const>
busbar-llm root units_llm.rs
busbar-mcp served busbar-mcp/src/mcp/method.rs ledger_tool_call CLASS_TOOL_CALLS
busbar-a2a served busbar-a2a/src/a2a/receive.rs ledger_hop_bytes CLASS_BYTES
busbar-voice session busbar-voice/src/runtime/metering.rs report_turn busbar-plane-streaming/src/session.rs class_counts CLASS_AUDIO_TOKENS_OUT
